run_mobilebert_for_sequence_classificati: run MobileBertForSequenceClassification to classify text sequences into labeled categories
run_mobilebert_for_question_answering: run MobileBertForQuestionAnswering to extract answer spans from a context passage
run_mobilebert_for_masked_lm: run MobileBertForMaskedLM to predict masked tokens in a sequence for language modeling
run_mobilebert_for_token_classification: run MobileBertForTokenClassification to assign labels to each token in a sequence
run_mobilebert_model: run MobileBertModel to encode input sequences and produce hidden state representations
